target: terminal log return / (sqrt(h) * known cash sigma60)
model: median quantile regression with L1 slope shrinkage
calibration: fixed 10/50/90 percentiles of calibration residuals; no test fitting
split: original qualified and purged package3 train/calibration/sealed_test membership; opened-test labels only for final evaluation
limitations: The historical test was previously opened for other research, not a pristine holdout.

Intervals are empirical reference ranges, not guaranteed coverage or extrema.
New point estimates for old scenarios are late-added calculations, never original issue-time forecasts.
